messages:
jamie: Quickfire polls time! 3 tiny things — drop your picks in order (one line each). I'll tally by 5pm. 1) Lunch: sandwich 🥪 / taco 🌮 / salad 🥗 2) Editor: VSCode / Vim / Emacs 3) Model pet name (one word, e.g., 'sparky', 'atlas')
maria: 1) sandwich 🥪 2) VSCode 3) atlas
sam: 1) taco 🌮 (always tacos) 2) Vim 3) sparky
devin: 1) salad 🥗 (trying to be healthy) 2) VSCode 3) quark
zoe: 1) sandwich 🥪 2) Emacs (old habits) 3) willow
kai: 1) taco 🌮 2) VSCode 3) atlas
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: staging rollout scheduled at 18:00 UTC — no impact to lunch choices :robot_face:
jamie: Nice spread. So far sandwiches 2, tacos 2, salad 1. Editors: VSCode 3, Vim 1, Emacs 1. Model names: atlas (2), sparky, quark, willow. Anyone want to change votes?
maria: sticking with sandwich + VSCode + atlas :thumbsup:
sam: tempting to switch editor to VSCode but loyalty to Vim stands :sunglasses:
devin: actually swapping to taco 🌮 if anyone wants to split order?
jamie: noted — final tally in 10m unless someone shouts. Also if you want me to place a group order, react with :money_with_wings: and I'll grab receipts.
zoe: reaction :money_with_wings:
kai: reaction :money_with_wings: :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Poll closed (automated): lunches - sandwich 2 / taco 3 / salad 1; editors - VSCode 3 / Vim 1 / Emacs 1; model names - atlas (2) wins (runner-ups: sparky, quark, willow)
jamie: Atlas it is. Will order tacos (closest majority) + one salad + two sandwiches. Team atlas sticker idea? :sticker_pls: 
maria: love the sticker idea :heart:
sam: atlas sticker = buy 2 :raised_hands:
jamie: Cool — thanks everyone. Results saved in #random if you want to reference later.
